topic: Debugging frame insertion logic and data saving
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on a bug encountered when adding frames, specifically an error indicating a null value in the `frame_id` column of the `frame_log` relation. It was determined that the function responsible for insertion did not account for potential new frames. The participants agreed to work together to resolve the saving logic issues related to frame handling and inventory data.
decisions: The team will fix the function so it correctly handles scenarios involving newly added frames.
